items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I never hear of him. Last time I heard of Porter, he was with Benny Carter.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I don't know if he plays clarinet at all now. I don't know. He's alive.
I never hear of him. Last time I heard of Porter, he was with Benny Carter. Yeah.
I think he's out on the west coast for a long time. Yeah. I don't think he's dead.
